title: Mounting Part Held Back from Workmanship Shares — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Road Hazard Protection and the mounting part held back from a workmanship share — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** When an adjustment credit settles a workmanship share on the set, the share's mounting part is held back from settlement, and that part follows the Road Hazard Protection certificate on the set:

| Certificate on the set | Mounting part held back |
|---|---|
| an active certificate whose plan includes mounting and balancing on replacements | none — no mounting part is left in the share |
| an active certificate whose plan does not include it | half of the line's mounting part |
| no active certificate | the line's mounting part |

The line's mounting part is the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire where the line charges mounting and balancing after the free workmanship period, and 0 where it does not. The part held back is never settled with the credit.

**Cases (hypothetical share of $80.00 on a line whose mounting part is $25.00):** active certificate including mounting — $80.00 is settleable; active certificate without it — $12.50 held back, $67.50 settleable; no active certificate — $25.00 held back, $55.00 settleable.
